description: This file provides common utility functions for message handling, file processing, content-type inference, schema dereferencing, and message manipulation in a language model SDK. It includes functions for message conversion, content extraction, file data extraction, MIME type inference, schema resolution, and message management, supporting operations across various provider integrations.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] handle_any_messages_to_chat_completion_str_messages_conversion( messages: Any, )
methods.description: Converts various message formats into a list of string messages suitable for chat completion APIs.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] handle_messages_with_content_list_to_str_conversion( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Converts messages that may have content as list into strings for easier processing.

methods.name: AllMessageValues strip_name_from_message(message: AllMessageValues, allowed_name_roles: List[str] = ["user"])
methods.description: Removes 'name' attribute from a message if role not in allowed list.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] strip_name_from_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], allowed_name_roles: List[str] = ["user"] )
methods.description: Removes 'name' attribute from all messages where role not in allowed list.

methods.name: AllMessageValues strip_none_values_from_message(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Removes key-value pairs with None values from a message dictionary.

methods.name: str convert_content_list_to_str( message: Union[AllMessageValues, ChatCompletionResponseMessage], )
methods.description: Converts message content, which may be a list or string, into a plain string.

methods.name: str get_str_from_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Concatenates message contents into a single string.

methods.name: bool is_non_content_values_set(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Checks if a message contains non-content data (attributes other than content, role, or name).

methods.name: bool _audio_or_image_in_message_content(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Detects if message content contains audio or image types.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] convert_openai_message_to_only_content_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Converts OpenAI message format to a simplified format containing only content strings.

methods.name: str get_content_from_model_response(response: Union[ModelResponse, dict])
methods.description: Extracts textual content from a model response object.

methods.name: Optional[Literal["user","assistant"]] detect_first_expected_role( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Determines whether 'user' or 'assistant' is expected first based on message history.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _insert_user_continue_message( messages: List[AllMessageValues], user_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionUserMessage], ensure_alternating_roles: bool, )
methods.description: Inserts a continue message for the user into a message list, ensuring role alternation.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _insert_assistant_continue_message( messages: List[AllMessageValues], assistant_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionAssistantMessage] = None, ensure_alternating_roles: bool = True, )
methods.description: Inserts assistant continuation messages between consecutive user messages.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] get_completion_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], assistant_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionAssistantMessage], user_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionUserMessage], ensure_alternating_roles: bool, )
methods.description: Generates a message list with ensured role alternation by inserting continue messages.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_format_from_file_id(file_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Determines the format string from a file ID, especially for managed files.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] update_messages_with_model_file_ids( messages: List[AllMessageValues], model_id: str, model_file_id_mapping: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]], )
methods.description: Updates message contents replacing file IDs with provider-specific IDs based on mapping.

methods.name: Union[str,List[Dict[str,Any]]] update_responses_input_with_model_file_ids( input: Any, )
methods.description: Replaces file IDs within API input structures, decoding unified file IDs if needed.

methods.name: ExtractedFileData extract_file_data(file_data: FileTypes)
methods.description: Extracts filename, content bytes, MIME type, and headers from various file input formats.

methods.name: None unpack_defs(schema: dict, defs: dict)
methods.description: Dereferences all $ref entries in a JSON schema, resolving nested definitions.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_image_mime_type_from_url(url: str)
methods.description: Determines MIME type from URL based on file extension.

methods.name: str infer_content_type_from_url_and_content( url: str, content: bytes, current_content_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Infers the MIME type using URL extension, magic bytes, or raises error.

methods.name: List[str] get_tool_call_names(tools: List[ChatCompletionToolParam])
methods.description: Extracts names of tools with function type from a list of tool parameters.

methods.name: bool is_function_call(optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Checks presence of function call definitions in optional parameters.

methods.name: List[str] get_file_ids_from_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Collects file IDs from messages where content contains file objects.

methods.name: bool check_is_function_call(logging_obj: "LoggingClass")
methods.description: Determines if a logging object indicates a function call based on optional_params.

methods.name: Any filter_value_from_dict(dictionary: dict, key: str, depth: int = 0)
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a specified key from nested dictionaries.

methods.name: "ChatCompletionImageObject" migrate_file_to_image_url( message: "ChatCompletionFileObject", )
methods.description: Converts a file-based message to an image_url message object.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_last_user_message(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Retrieves the last block of consecutive user messages as a single string.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] set_last_user_message( messages: List[AllMessageValues], content: str )
methods.description: Replaces the last block of user messages with a new message.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] convert_prefix_message_to_non_prefix_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Transforms prefixed messages into regular messages with system prompts.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _extract_reasoning_content(message: dict)
methods.description: Extracts reasoning and main content from messages, handling embedded reasoning tags.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _parse_content_for_reasoning( message_text: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Uses regex to parse reasoning segments within message content.

methods.name: List[str] extract_images_from_message(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Retrieves list of image URLs embedded in message content.
